technical_and_design_decisions: Upgrade Reactor to 2.0.4 directly, assuming compatibility with existing code and minimal refactoring.
Configure Ambari for HA XD-Admin servers using clustering and load balancing techniques.
Implement @EnableModule annotation-driven model by leveraging Spring's annotation processing and reflection for bean creation.
Complete Kryo optimization with a focus on performance tuning and clear documentation guidelines.
Migrate 1.2.x branch to EC2 infrastructure for CI reliability, utilizing cloud setup and automated testing.
Investigate Maven integration for XD module installation using artifact resolution and CLI-based deployment.
Move serialization code from Spring XD to Spring Integration to centralize functionality and improve dependency management.
Implement CloudController based XD Admin SPI for CF by building on existing spike deliverables and integrating with Spring Cloud components.
assumptions: Development environment is already set up with access to all required repositories and tools.
Existing test suites are comprehensive and can be extended for new features.
Documentation updates are included in each activity and follow standard practices.
The investigation for U6 is time-boxed to yield practical recommendations without extensive coding.
All dependencies, including Reactor 2.0.4 and other libraries, are available and compatible with Java 17+.
The team has familiarity with the codebase, reducing ramp-up time for new implementations.

activities.activity_description: Update Reactor version to 2.0.4 in build files, run compatibility tests, and update release notes to leverage improvements and bug-fixes.
Modify Ambari configuration to support multiple XD-Admin server instances, update cluster setup scripts, and perform high-availability testing.
Design and implement the @EnableModule annotation for module programming model, update module creation logic to use annotation-driven approach, write unit and integration tests, and document usage.
Review and finalize existing Kryo optimization changes, implement remaining code improvements, polish documentation, and establish guidelines.
Set up EC2 instances for CI infrastructure, migrate test suites, configure automated build and test pipelines, and verify reliability for continuous integration.
Research and prototype techniques for installing XD modules from a Maven repository, define artifact resolution from CLI, and document findings for future implementation.
Extract serialization code from Spring XD, move it to Spring Integration repository, update XD dependencies to use the new location, and test functionality across systems.
Study existing spike deliverables, implement CloudController based XD Admin SPI for Cloud Foundry, integrate with Spring Cloud components, and test data pipeline use-cases.
